item.title: রাজধানীতে ছুটির দিনের বিনোদন আয়োজন
item.description: শুক্রবার ছুটির দিনে ঢাকা শহরে নাটক ও সংগীতের পাশাপাশি স্ট্যান্ডআপ কমেডি শোসহ নানা সাংস্কৃতিক অনুষ্ঠান উপভোগ করা যাবে।

item.title: টিভিতে আজকের খেলাধুলা (১৩ নভেম্বর ২০২৬)
item.description: আজ টিভিতে রাওয়ালপিন্ডি টেস্টের শেষ দিন, ভারত-নিউজিল্যান্ড ও অস্ট্রেলিয়া-ইংল্যান্ড ওয়ানডে ম্যাচ এবং নেশনস লিগের খেলা দেখা যাবে।

item.title: শৈশবে হুমায়ূন আহমেদের ঘুরে বেড়ানোর দিনগুলো
item.description: চাকরি সূত্রে ফয়জুর রহমানের বদলি হওয়ায় হুমায়ূন আহমেদ তার শৈশবে পরিবারের সঙ্গে বিভিন্ন স্থানে ঘুরেছেন, যা তার আত্মজীবনীতে উঠে এসেছে।

item.title: শহরের কৃত্রিম আলো ও লোডশেডিংয়ের অন্ধকার
item.description: ঢাকার কৃত্রিম আলোর বিপরীতে গ্রামের ঘন অন্ধকার বা লোডশেডিংয়ের সময়কার আসল অন্ধকার সম্পূর্ণ ভিন্ন প্রকৃতির। বিদ্যুৎ যাওয়ার কারণে তৈরি হওয়া এই অন্ধকার নিয়েই মূলত মানুষের নানা অভিযোগ।

item.title: Pat Cummins dismisses Usman Khawaja's sandpaper claims
item.description: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins has strongly rejected Usman Khawaja's remarks regarding the sandpaper controversy, labeling them entirely false and incorrect.

item.title: Donald Trump suggests Tim Cook should lead Nvidia
item.description: Following Jensen Huang's resignation, Donald Trump has publicly suggested that Tim Cook take over as Nvidia's CEO. Currently, the company's chief financial officer is serving as the interim head.

item.title: Cummins rejects Khawaja's 2018 Cape Town claims
item.description: The Australian skipper has dismissed suggestions by Usman Khawaja that the entire team was aware of the ball tampering during the 2018 match, calling the allegations entirely inaccurate.

item.title: Uncertainty remains over the conflict in Tigray
item.description: Ethiopian forces have secured control over most major urban centers in Tigray, though the remaining combat strength of the TPLF stays uncertain.

item.title: Sriperumbudur Toll Plaza Implements Multi-Lane Free-Flow System
item.description: The toll station has introduced automated scanners capable of processing license plates and FASTag accounts. This technology enables direct electronic fee collection without stopping vehicles.

item.title: Australian Captain Pat Cummins Addresses Usman Khawaja's Book Claims
item.description: During a media briefing, cricket captain Pat Cummins dismissed allegations made by Usman Khawaja regarding the 2018 ball-tampering controversy as completely untrue. He defended the integrity of the team's operations.

item.title: Morning Digest: Sonam Wangchuk says restrictions on him arbitrary, vague; Centre sanctions new roads, infrastructure along China’s border, and more
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, Here is a select list of stories to start the day. Key points: Morning Digest, Sonam Wangchuk, Centre, China.

item.title: Regulator Warns Junior Doctor Burnout Threatens Maternity Care
item.description: New findings indicate that medical trainees handling childbirth are facing higher rates of exhaustion compared to other fields. Authorities caution that this severe overwork endangers expectant mothers.

item.title: US Defence Secretary Honors Soldier for War Memorial Admonition
item.description: Pete Hegseth awarded Specialist Thomas Iglesias the Joint Service Commendation Medal. The soldier was recognized for demanding quiet and reverence at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier on Veterans Day.

item.title: Accused Former Officer Purchased Alias SIM Card Prior to Killings
item.description: A Sydney court heard testimony from former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon regarding a covert SIM card. The defendant stated he acquired it under a fake name to gather reports about workplace bullying.

item.title: US Congress Steps Up Scrutiny Of Trump, Jensen Huang Over National Security
item.description: As reported by NDTV, Huang, a co-founder of the AI chip giant, on Sunday acknowledged an affair with Alice Huang, a former executive at Singapore. Key points: Congress Steps Up Scrutiny Of Trump, Jensen Huang Over National Security Huang, Sunday, Alice Huang.

item.title: Duran Duran Drummer Roger Taylor Exits Band Over Health Concerns
item.description: Roger Taylor has departed from the music group Duran Duran after a 47-year tenure, citing ongoing health challenges related to tinnitus. He shared the decision through a personal statement on social media.

item.title: Xbox Reveals Wolfenstein 3 Development
item.description: Xbox has officially confirmed a new sequel to Wolfenstein II: The New Colossus. MachineGames will develop the upcoming title, nearly ten years after the release of the 2017 predecessor.

item.title: Trump Says Gulf Nations Sought Halt to Iran Strikes
item.description: During a White House appearance, Donald Trump stated that regional allies in the Gulf requested a suspension of military actions against Iran.

item.title: Cummins Rejects Khawaja's Ball-Tampering Claims
item.description: Australian cricket captain Pat Cummins has firmly rejected allegations from teammate Usman Khawaja about the 2018 sandpaper incident. Cummins reiterated that he had no prior knowledge of the ball-tampering plot.

item.title: Mookuthi Amman 2 Reaches Rs 17.93 Crore
item.description: The Nayanthara-starrer 'Mookuthi Amman 2' earned 75 lakh on its seventh day, bringing its domestic total to Rs 17.93 crore. The Tamil version drove the majority of these ticket sales.

item.title: Houthis Target Saudi Arabia Amid UNSC Sanctions
item.description: The UN Security Council extended sanctions as Houthi forces launched fresh drone attacks on Saudi military and oil sites. A Saudi-led coalition intercepted the incoming aerial threats.

item.title: West Bengal Sees Surge in Attacks on Churches
item.description: Christian home fellowships and churches in West Bengal have faced a sharp increase in assaults following the BJP's rise to power in the summer of 2026. This trend has left the local Christian community deeply concerned.

item.title: 'Ramayana' day 8: Ranbir, Yash, Sai starrer enters Rs 1,000 Cr club
item.description: As reported by TOI Entertainment, Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana. Key points: Ramayana, Ranbir, Yash, Nitesh Tiwari.

item.title: Draft electoral rolls for SSR published in 13 states, 3 UTs; UP to release on Nov 17
item.description: As reported by Hindustan Times, Bihar’s list adds about 1.3 million electors over its post-SIR roll. Key points: Draft, Bihar, Tamil Nadu, million.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid controversy
item.description: Jensen Huang has stepped down as head of Nvidia, throwing the semiconductor enterprise into uncertainty. American legislators intend to examine him regarding a potential connection with a Chinese intelligence operative.

item.title: Main suspect in Chhattisgarh liquor scandal captured in UAE
item.description: Authorities in the United Arab Emirates have apprehended the primary suspect linked to Chhattisgarh's alcohol scam. The investigation involves the unlawful distribution of untaxed and unrecorded beverages via government-run shops.

item.title: স্পেনকে থামানো যাচ্ছে না, চেক প্রজাতন্ত্রকে হারিয়ে জয় অব্যাহত
item.description: নেশনস লিগে চেক প্রজাতন্ত্রকে ২-০ গোলে পরাজিত করেছে স্পেন। লুয়েস দে লাফুয়েন্তের দল এই জয়ের মাধ্যমে প্রতিযোগিতায় টানা পঞ্চম সাফল্য অর্জন করল।

item.title: FBI confiscates $1.2 billion in digital assets stolen from Binance
item.description: Federal authorities announced Thursday the recovery of over $1.2 billion in digital currency. The funds had been reported stolen from the major cryptocurrency platform Binance during the previous month.

item.title: Whoop debuts a new social platform centered on verified biometrics
item.description: Whoop released a dedicated social application on Thursday allowing wearable users to share physiological metrics. Members can broadcast their activities, statistics, and photo updates with fellow device owners.

item.title: Suriya and Naslen's movie 'Scene' surpasses Rs 200 crore globally
item.description: The Jithu Madhavan-directed feature starring Suriya and Naslen has exceeded Rs 200 crore in global box office earnings. The picture demonstrated robust financial results internationally and domestically within its first week.

item.title: India's inflation exceeds RBI limit, fueling rate hike expectations
item.description: Higher food costs and widespread price growth across consumer categories pushed inflation past the central bank's six percent threshold. Analysts now anticipate a quarter-point interest rate increase by the Reserve Bank of India in December.

item.title: Specialists caution against deceptive AI alterations in real estate
item.description: Industry professionals caution that utilizing artificial intelligence to alter real estate photographs can cross the line from improvement into deception for potential purchasers.

item.title: Trump Comments on Former Nvidia Chief and Alleged Spy Link
item.description: Donald Trump stated he is uncertain if a woman associated with Jensen Huang acted as a spy. A published report also claims the former Nvidia CEO was involved in a third affair.

item.title: Two Missing Special Police Officers Found Dead in Kishtwar
item.description: Two Special Police Officers previously reported missing were discovered shot to death in the Kishtwar region of Jammu and Kashmir. Meanwhile, a court requested home department data regarding thousands of personnel facing stalled pay.

item.title: Trump Calls Nvidia Spy Controversy Horrible Following Huang Resignation
item.description: Donald Trump labeled the situation a terrible event in an interview following Jensen Huang's resignation. He mentioned the former tech executive while addressing Chinese espionage and artificial intelligence.

item.title: FIFA Fails to Block UEFA Investigation Into Gianni Infantino
item.description: A New York judge rejected FIFA's request to prevent UEFA from gathering evidence against its president. European soccer authorities are pursuing information regarding alleged misconduct by Gianni Infantino.

item.title: Humble Bundle Redesign Omits Two-Factor Authentication Settings
item.description: The digital storefront Humble Bundle launched a layout update that removed account options for managing two-factor authentication. Reports from gaming outlets highlighted the missing security setting on the user page.

item.title: Russian Rights Lawyer Sentenced to 12 Years for Treason
item.description: A Russian court convicted a human rights lawyer of treason, sentencing her to 12 years in prison. State prosecutors alleged she provided security information to Ukraine, whereas her defense maintained the data was not classified.

item.title: Global Outage Affects Microsoft Outlook Service
item.description: Users worldwide have experienced disruptions accessing their Outlook email via applications and web browsers. Microsoft acknowledged the service failure through its status communications channel.

item.title: Canada and Trade Partners Discuss Professional Mobility
item.description: The sixth session of CEPA trade discussions is currently active. Both nations intend to settle remaining matters by November to finalize the agreement.

item.title: ইংল্যান্ড বনাম ক্রোয়েশিয়া নেশনস লিগ ম্যাচ ফলাফল
item.description: ওয়েন্টিলিতে ক্রোয়েশিয়াকে ২-১ গোলে হারিয়ে নেশনস লিগের শেষ আটে জায়গা করে নিয়েছে ইংল্যান্ড। হ্যারি কেইন পেনাল্টি থেকে জয়সূচক গোল করে দেশের হয়ে সর্বোচ্চ ১২৬টি ম্যাচ খেলার রেকর্ডটি স্মরণীয় করে রাখেন।

item.title: Montana Supreme Court Denies Father's Custody Appeal
item.description: Montana's highest court upheld a lower ruling against Justin Aikins's request to modify his parenting plan. Aikins sought the changes after his former spouse relocated an additional 10 miles away, but the court ruled the minor distance shift was insufficient.

item.title: US Upheaval Follows Jensen Huang Allegations
item.description: Reports regarding an alleged secondary affair involving Jensen Huang have generated significant public reaction across the United States.

item.title: Meta Introduces Paid AI Assistant for Phone Calls
item.description: Subscribers can now utilize Meta's Muse artificial intelligence agent to handle phone tasks. The tool is capable of booking reservations, setting up appointments, and remaining on hold during calls.

item.title: Morgan Rogers Defends Cole Palmer's England Commitment
item.description: Morgan Rogers has strongly rejected claims that Cole Palmer lacks dedication to the England national squad, dismissing the rumors as entirely false.

item.title: Sukhbir Badal Expected to Meet Amit Shah to Discuss Alliance
item.description: Shiromani Akali Dal insiders indicate Sukhbir Badal will travel to New Delhi following a Raikot rally to confer with Amit Shah. Discussions will likely center on seat allocations and a potential SAD-BJP coalition.

item.title: Houthis Report Drone Attacks on Saudi Capital and Military Bases
item.description: Houthi representatives stated that their forces executed drone strikes targeting Riyadh and various Saudi military installations. The group also claimed a renewed drone assault on a petroleum pumping station on the East-West pipeline.

item.title: Microsoft Tests New Dashboard and Background Features for Xbox
item.description: Microsoft is rolling out fresh dashboard features for Xbox Insiders to evaluate. Testing includes rotating wallpapers, updated digital game library layouts, and the option to relocate the Guide menu to the right side of the screen.

item.title: ইতালির কাছে ৩-১ গোলে হেরে গেল ফ্রান্স
item.description: ম্যাচে পিছিয়ে পড়ার পর পিও এসপোজিতোর দুটি এবং ডেভিদে ফ্রাত্তেসির একটি গোলে ফ্রান্সকে ৩-১ ব্যবধানে পরাজিত করে ইতালি। সান সিরোয় এই জয়ের ফলে নেশনস লিগের গ্রুপ টেবিলের শীর্ষস্থান দখল করেছে তারা।

item.title: AAP Unveils Additional Nominees for Punjab Legislative Elections
item.description: The Aam Aadmi Party has named its next wave of contenders for the upcoming Punjab legislature elections. This roster features two current members of the Lok Sabha, Raj Kumar Chabbewal and Gurmeet Singh Meet Hayer, running in Phagwara and Barnala respectively.

item.title: Democratic Lawmakers Open Second Inquiry into Nvidia and CEO
item.description: Democratic members of Congress have initiated a fresh probe concerning Nvidia, dispatching a sharp letter regarding CEO Jensen Huang's interactions with Donald Trump. This marks the second congressional investigation following reports of a suspected espionage incident involving Chinese sales.

item.title: American Cancer Society Updates Guidance to Recommend Prostate Screening
item.description: Reversing prior stances, the American Cancer Society now advises all average-risk males aged 50 to 69 to undergo a PSA test every two years. The updated guideline aims to catch prostate cancer early.

item.title: Milburn Review Suggests Reduced Welfare Payments for Young Adults
item.description: A proposed welfare system restructuring recommends lowering primary sickness payments for individuals under twenty-five years of age.

item.title: West Bengal Administration Plans SLP Over Frozen Municipal Elections
item.description: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced that the West Bengal administration will file a Special Leave Petition in the Supreme Court to challenge the ongoing suspension of municipal elections. Should the freeze remain, the government intends to designate specific coordinators.

item.title: Muse Introduces Paid Outbound Calling Feature for American Firms
item.description: Artificial intelligence platform Muse now offers a paid service capable of initiating outbound telephone calls to commercial entities across the United States. Users must pay a fee to utilize this new calling capability.

item.title: Gauff Overcomes Back Pain to Secure Victory at WTA Finals
item.description: Despite struggling with a back injury, Coco Gauff overcame Marta Kostyuk in a hard-fought match. The win preserves her chances of advancing to the final four of the tournament.

item.title: BBC Report Highlights Leadership Confidence Crisis Within Scottish NHS
item.description: BBC Scotland health correspondent Lisa Summers examines the severe criticism directed at NHS Grampian. The report sheds light on a broader crisis of confidence concerning executive leadership across Scotland's healthcare system.

item.title: Italy Defeats France 3-1 to Claim Top Spot in Nations League Group
item.description: Despite Michael Olise putting France ahead, Italy rallied with goals from Davide Frattesi and two from Pio Esposito. The 3-1 victory lifts the Italian squad to the summit of their Nations League group standings.

item.title: Oklahoma homeowner penalized over short-term rentals
item.description: An Oklahoma property owner must pay over $8,500 in penalties following a legal dispute. The Supreme Court ruling also upholds a neighborhood prohibition against short-term lodging after he hosted 141 visitors.

item.title: Microsoft services and Outlook experience disruptions
item.description: A major technical disruption impacted multiple Microsoft platforms. Thousands of users experienced difficulties accessing Outlook, the Teams communication application, the Copilot AI tool, and other Microsoft 365 offerings.
